title: App not showing up in Play Store on Wear OS watch
body:
Wear OS version: `2.33`
xDrip+ version: `49817a5-2021.10.04`
Phone Android version: `12`

The ["Watch Guide" instructions](https://github.com/jamorham/xDrip-plus/blob/master/Documentation/WatchGuide.md#enable-xdrip-android-wear-integration) say to install the app via Play Store _on the watch_, but when I look under "Apps on your phone" it's not there. I have installed a few other apps that way in the past.
 I installed xDrip+ on my phone via the QR code from the main page.
